au.csiro.JamesGunning.seismicinverter
Class OneDSeismicConvolutionalModel

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--au.csiro.JamesGunning.seismicinverter.OneDSeismicConvolutionalModel
public final class OneDSeismicConvolutionalModel
extends java.lang.Object

Simple 1d, no-multiples convolutional model of seismic response using Zoepritz reflection coefficients to second order in incidence angle, first order in property-changes.

generateSyntheticTrace_kernel

void generateSyntheticTrace_kernel(OneDSeismicConvolutionalModel.Wavelet wavelet)
The kernel of the synthetic seismic generator. Usable without a sane Model and SeismicInverter context, but easily wrapped when that context exists (see generateSyntheticTrace() ). In this case the Wavelet argument will be null. Without the inverter context, requires a Wavelet object to be sensibly setup. The internal fields layer_top_times[] and R_near[] have to be sensibly filled before calling this kernel. note the R_near[i] is an array of successive reflection coefficients, which, in the presence of pinchouts, may not necessarily mean the reflection coefficient from layer i-1 to layer i.

dumpSynthetics

public void dumpSynthetics(boolean newState,
                           int realisation_number,
                           boolean write_state)
method to dump synthetic seismic of realisation. If newState==true, the current synthetic (from the proposal) will be dumped, otherwise the synthetic of the last accepted proposal (the current chain state) will be dumped. The realisation number is written into the header field realisationNumberHeaderField

getRickerCorrelationLengthLambda

double getRickerCorrelationLengthLambda()
Useful function to get estimate of length scale of wavelet. Calculations here assume spectral form W(f) ~ f^2 exp(-f^2 lambda^2 / 2) or, in time, W(t) ~ (1-(2 pi t/lambda)^2) * exp(-(2 pi t)^2 / 2 lambda^2). From frequency spectrum, lambda is defined from bandedge by lambda = 3/freq_at_bandedge.
